mapper.select: SELECT ar.student_id AS studentId, ar.word_id AS wordId, ar.class_id AS classId, COUNT(*) AS wrongCount FROM answer_record ar WHERE ar.is_correct = 0 AND ar.answered_at >= #{startInclusive} AND ar.answered_at < #{endExclusive} GROUP BY ar.student_id, ar.word_id, ar.class_id HAVING COUNT(*) > 3
